Question:
What plane figure is formed when the lateral surface of a cylinder is unfolded?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_050_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: Cutting the lateral surface along the height of the cylinder and flattening it produces a rectangle. Its length is the circumference of the circular base, and its width is the height of the cylinder.
